claims.text: The study's index carries the entry 'Norton, Garrison | 14-15, 31, 70, 260, 331' and no entry for Norton Air Force Base. Every occurrence of the string Norton across the front matter, chapters 2, 6 and 7, the index and the appendices is Garrison Norton, the Navy Assistant Secretary for Research and Development, whom the bibliography records being interviewed by Welzenbach on 23 May 1983.
